title: WheelSpeed-Front Placement Editor
note: One editor for both wheel speed harnesses (Dan X9, 2026-11-11). Routes drawn by Claude in the wireway corridors (Dan 2026-11-11); move devices only. Conditioners in the centre console just behind the ECU (Dan); sensors on each wheel knuckle under the strut tower (body manual under-body plan; 1993 service manual: one sensor on each wheel hub), +300 mm drop; front cables under the dash and the kick panels, out the LH / RH fender pass-throughs; rear cables along the console, under the front edge of the rear seat, then along the floor to each rear knuckle.
